            sd = base.loc[name, 'std']

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='mixed')
anomaly_date = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-16')

keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
piv = df.pivot_table(index=keys, columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
piv = piv.sort_index()

on_col = anomaly_date
other_cols = [c for c in piv.columns if c != anomaly_date]

rows = []
for idx, r in piv.iterrows():
    on = r[on_col]
    others = r[other_cols]
    m = others.mean()
    sd = others.std()
    mx = others.max()
    rows.append(list(idx) + [on, m, sd, mx, on-m, (on-m)/sd if sd>0 else np.nan])

res = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=keys + ['on','mean','std','max','delta','z'])
res['abs_delta'] = res['delta'].abs()
res = res.sort_values('abs_delta', ascending=False)
print(res.head(20).to_string())
print()
# Also check price and num_instances deviations at leaf level
for metric in ['price','num_instances']:
    piv2 = df.pivot_table(index=keys, columns='date', values=metric, aggfunc='sum')
    rows2 = []
    for idx, r in piv2.iterrows():
        on = r[on_col]
        others = r[other_cols]
        m = others.mean()
        rows2.append(list(idx) + [on, m, on-m])
    res2 = pd.DataFrame(rows2, columns=keys + ['on','mean','delta'])
    res2['abs_delta'] = res2['delta'].abs()
    res2 = res2.sort_values('abs_delta', ascending=False)
    print(metric)
    print(res2.head(10).to_string())
    print()
